strategy.label: top-down model: the three reagents the dataset names, amounts from the two reaction equations with molar masses, utilities calibrated
strategy.note: NOT S1. No report in the bundle prints an inventory. The dataset's ecoSpold technology field names the complete reagent list - 'production out of phosgene, aniline and formaldehyde' - and BAFU carries a real unit process for each one ('Phosgene, liquid, at plant', 'Aniline, at plant', 'Formaldehyde, production mix, at plant'), so this model terminates on the database with no aggregated dependency. Two steps, both named by the technology field. Condensation: 2 C6H7N (aniline, 186.258) + CH2O (formaldehyde, 30.026) -> C13H14N2 (methylenedianiline, 198.269) + H2O (18.015); 216.284 = 216.284. Phosgenation: C13H14N2 + 2 COCl2 (197.820) -> C15H10N2O2 (MDI, 250.257) + 4 HCl (145.832); 396.089 = 396.089. Per kg of MDI: 186.258/250.257 = 0.74426 kg aniline, 30.026/250.257 = 0.11998 kg formaldehyde, 197.820/250.257 = 0.79046 kg phosgene; co-products 0.58273 kg HCl and 0.07199 kg water. Mass balance of the whole model: 1.6547 kg in, 1.6547 kg out. Molar masses from the IUPAC 2021 standard atomic weights: H 1.008, C 12.011, N 14.007, O 15.999, S 32.06, Cl 35.45, Na 22.990. The hydrogen chloride co-product (0.583 kg per kg of MDI, more than half the product mass) is recorded in this note and given no credit, because nothing in the bundle states an allocation. Amounts are fixed, not fitted: they are the stoichiometric floor at 100 % conversion. Known gaps: the hydrochloric acid catalyst of the condensation step and the chlorobenzene/monochlorobenzene solvent of the phosgenation, both recycled and neither quantified anywhere; and the polymeric-MDI fraction, which the dataset does not distinguish.

evidence.where: Cumene / Ethyl benzene / Phosgene / Aniline, at plant [RER]
evidence.note: BAFU template, not a report figure. Every ecoinvent-v2 organic-chemical unit process in BAFU-2026 carries the same five-line utility block: 0.333 kWh of 'Electricity, medium voltage, production ENTSO-E, at grid', 2.0 MJ of 'Heat, natural gas, at industrial furnace 1MW' [CH], 4.0E-10 units of 'Chemical plant, organics', and transport at 0.6 tkm rail + 0.1 tkm lorry per kilogram of precursor. Verified exchange by exchange on Cumene, at plant (0.684 kg benzene + 0.369 kg propylene = 1.053 kg of precursor -> 0.632 tkm rail, 0.105 tkm lorry), Ethyl benzene, at plant (1.030 -> 0.619 / 0.103), Phosgene, liquid, at plant (1.040 -> 0.624 / 0.104) and Aniline, at plant (1.352 -> 0.814 / 0.136). That is the named template this amount comes from.

node.name: Methylene diphenyl diisocyanate, at plant, disaggregated
node.comment: Condensation of aniline with formaldehyde and phosgenation of the resulting diamine, per kg of MDI. The eight waste-treatment services that the BAFU dataset already carries as explicit exchanges are deliberately not part of this model - they were never collapsed away - following the committed PlasticsEurope specs. The consequence, measured in results/checks/, is that the target's cumulative vector gets a long tail of flows from those disposal chains that no model omitting them can reach.
